categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen SINE Electric Co., Ltd. specializes in industrial automation, focusing on motor drives and control systems. Its primary products include general-purpose frequency converters, integrated special machines, servo systems, controllers, and new energy products. The company serves industries such as logistics, construction machinery, petrochemical, wire and cable, plastics, textiles, woodworking, air compressors, CNC machine tools, printing and packaging, metal rolling, building materials, and pumps.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including inverter control, peripheral interface technology, and industry application technology. It employs advanced vector control, high-precision servo drive technology, embedded computer control, and power electronics. Production combines stock-based and order-based manufacturing, supported by ERP systems and automated testing equipment to ensure quality and efficiency. R&D follows a matrix management model with IPD project management and multi-level review processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are machinery equipment manufacturers and electrical control system integrators in industrial automation and new energy sectors. The company targets OEM customers and project-based clients in industries such as petrochemical, power, logistics, construction machinery, and manufacturing. It also serves emerging markets like automotive electronics and robotics through its servo systems and motor products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic market penetration. It has expanded overseas sales rapidly, especially in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Eastern Europe, establishing a global sales network with multiple high-tier channel partners. Headquarters and R&D centers are located in Shenzhen and Wuhan, with subsidiaries in Suzhou and Wuxi.
categories.supply_chain_position: SINE Electric operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial automation supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of motor drives, controllers, and integrated automation solutions. It procures core components like IGBT and IC chips, some of which are imported, and manages a strategic supplier base to optimize costs and ensure supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent, integrated, and green technologies. R&D focuses on enhancing inverter and servo system performance, integrating drive and control functions, and developing customized solutions for diverse industrial applications. It invests in digital transformation of R&D processes and infrastructure upgrades, including new test platforms and energy storage integration. Strategic acquisitions, such as the full acquisition of Tenghe Motor, aim to strengthen the servo motor technology and product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of frequency converters, integrated special machines, servo systems, controllers, and new energy products. Sales channels include direct sales to large customers, distribution through dealers for smaller OEMs, and project-based sales for industrial clients. Overseas sales are mainly through distributors. The company also benefits from government subsidies and tax incentives related to high-tech and manufacturing sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants like Siemens and ABB, as well as domestic leaders such as Inovance and Invt. It holds a competitive position in mid-to-low-end markets with growing penetration into high-end segments through technology innovation and acquisitions. SINE Electric is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion', reflecting its strong niche market presence and technical capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 366.8 million, a slight decrease of 1.72% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 37.8 million, down 26%. R&D investment increased to 10% of revenue, reflecting a growth focus. Total assets reached RMB 924 million, with equity of RMB 760 million. Overseas sales grew rapidly by 165%, indicating strong international expansion momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SINE Electric emphasizes customer-centric innovation, delivering high-performance, reliable, and energy-efficient automation products tailored to specific industry needs. Its integrated solutions reduce system costs and improve equipment reliability. The company’s proprietary technologies in vector control and servo drives, combined with customized application expertise, provide competitive differentiation. Strategic acquisitions enhance its full-chain capabilities from R&D to manufacturing, supporting sustainable growth and superior customer service.
